errors.what: Crank rotates clockwise instead of counter-clockwise. After t=0 the crank pin A moves below the X axis (t=0.33 about -30 deg, t=1.00 pointing straight down) where CCW motion would put it above (+30 deg, +90 deg). At t=3.00 the crank points up, where the spec requires it to point down (270 deg). Link lengths, ground pivots and the assembly branch (B above the X axis at t=0) look correct.
